blocks.html:
Lettering and Decals – Apex Construction

The well-known construction firm Apex Consulting and Management has happy clients. They hoped to boost both their clients and the exposure of their brand. Our staff at Vinyl Wrap Toronto advised fleet decals as one of the greatest forms of advertising when they came to us for assistance. Your corporate vehicle may be customized with decals, making it a mobile billboard. Even when you are only out to grab lunch, a branded vehicle may bring in business and draw in consumers.

Our graphic designers started to work since Apex Construction enjoyed the concept of casually growing their present client base. Together, we decided on a vivid blue for their corporate identity. On the sides and back of their F-Series pickup truck, the emblem was strategically mounted along with their contact information in white vinyl. While being put on a black background, these vivid vinyl hues stood out and blended perfectly.

In less than four working days, the black Ford F-Series pickup truck was back in service. This speedy response minimized scheduling downtime and ensured client satisfaction.

Like Apex Construction, if you own a business, and want to increase your brand visibility and the size of your clientele by simply driving around in the city, Vinyl Wrap Toronto is the one-stop shop for you. We personally would like to thank Apex Construction for trusting Vinyl Wrap Toronto with its mobile billboards.

To check out our previous projects and get inspired for your next car wrap, go to our Portfolio.

Get a Free Quote by filling out the form and our team will get back to you as soon as possible.

You can also visit us at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 or call us at 416-746-1381 to get an estimated truck wrap cost.

Don’t forget to follow us on Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, and Pinterest to hear about our special deals, creative wrap projects, and vehicle branding.
